specification.preconditions: operand.length = operator.length + 1 ∧ 2 ≤ operand.length ∧ (∀ x ∈ operand, 0 ≤ x) ∧ ∀ o ∈ operator, o = "+" ∨ o = "-" ∨ o = "*" ∨ o = "//" ∨ o = "**"

metadata.note: the specification reduces the highest-precedence operator first (the rightmost of the ** ones, else the leftmost); nonnegative operands make // and ** agree with Python
